[EN] With soldiers like you, we've really cleaned house against the kingdom's enemies here, but Spirit Outpost is still bogged down.

Get over there and meet with {@LinkCreature:223#1017$$Naikara}.
[ES] Con soldados como tú, realmente hemos limpiado la casa contra los enemigos del reino aquí, pero Spirit Outpost sigue estancado.

Ve allá y reúnete con {@LinkCreature:223#1017$$Naikara}.

[EN] Most of our reserve troops are battling the vampir rebels near Popolion.

If you can help half as much as Menani says, you'll be a great asset.
[ES] La mayor parte de nuestras tropas de reserva está luchando contra los rebeldes vampir cerca de Popolion.

Si puedes ayudar ni la mitad de lo que dice Menani, serás de gran ayuda.
